lessons.title: Join URL Paths
lessons.description: Implement join_url(base, path) avoiding double/missing slashes. The test checks that join_url('https://api.com/', '/v1/users') equals 'https://api.com/v1/users'; join_url('https://api.com', 'v1') equals 'https://api.com/v1'.
learning_objectives: Harbor potters recount crates before dawn, and build API URLs safely.
lessons.solution_code:
def join_url(base, path):
    return base.rstrip('/') + '/' + path.lstrip('/')

source.name: Python docs — String Methods — str.rstrip() / str.lstrip()

lessons.title: Merge Headers
lessons.description: Implement merge_headers(base, extra) — extra wins on conflicts. The test checks that merge_headers({'A': '1'}, {'A': '2', 'B': '3'}) equals {'A': '2', 'B': '3'}.
learning_objectives: Quarry potters recount crates before dawn, and merge HTTP headers.
lessons.solution_code:
def merge_headers(base, extra):
    out = dict(base)
    out.update(extra)
    return out

def test_build_request(self):
    r = build_request('post', '/x', json_body={'a': 1})
    self.assertEqual(r['method'], 'POST')

    self.assertIn('"a"', r['body'])
